principle: The hero is a band, not a poster: a text safe zone on the left, the truck / AIO building in the right image zone. Images are art-directed per viewport (object-fit: cover + focal point); never stretched or distorted.

implementation.component: AioMigrationHero (AioMigrationKit.tsx) — renders <picture class="amg-hero__plate"> with tablet and desktop sources

FULL.use: LANDING (root) and ARRIVAL (welcome to your office)
FULL.MOBILE: authority hero over the family environment plate (env-root.jpg / env-existing.jpg / env-active.jpg) — locked

DESKTOP.bandHeight: 278px (68 → 346), across the workspace (right of the sidebar)

FULL.ARRIVAL: keeps the full-page environment (env-active.jpg, fixed) with a left light scrim — celebratory, no band crop

COMPACT.use: every working screen (path select, upload, processing, review, tables, detail, confirmation, invite, batch, client activation)

TABLET.title: 46px / 42px, phone line breaks reflowed into the safe zone
TABLET.subtitle: 14.5px / 20px, max-width min(46%, 420px)

COMPACT.scrim: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(248,246,242,.82) 0%, .62 32%, 0 58%) between plate and text

NONE.use: reserved for future dense utility pages (e.g. a full-screen table)
NONE.rule: no band; the content starts one SECTION_GAP under the header

text.DESKTOP: left 44% of the band (truck starts at ≈ 52% of the plate)

safeZones.image: right 54–56%: truck, trailer and the AIO building; never covered by text
safeZones.rule: hero text right edge ≤ band left + 62% of band width (validated per screen by responsive-qa)

TABLET.source: hero band of masters/AIO-MIG-ROOT-TABLET-834x1194.png, baked headline removed (inpaint + haze, same treatment as the phone plates)

DESKTOP.source: hero band of masters/AIO-MIG-ROOT-DESKTOP-1440x900.png, baked headline removed

plates.loading: the <picture> has no mobile source (1×1 placeholder) so phones never download the wide plates
plates.edge: 22px mask fade at the band bottom into the page

transformations.MOBILE→TABLET: absolute authority lockup → flowed band; family plate → wide tablet plate; headline keeps its line breaks (FULL) or reflows into the safe zone (COMPACT); band height fixed per mode instead of the authority's panel top
transformations.TABLET→DESKTOP: band moves into the workspace (right of the 138px sidebar); shorter band (278 / 232); desktop plate with the truck fully in frame; kicker tracking tightens; subtitle grows to 18px on FULL
